No time cap

Move in / move out

Make your move easier by having us do the cleaning before you move in or after you move out. We clean and polish all the appliances inside and out, clean inside all the cabinets and drawers, scrub the bathrooms and remove all the dust and dirt from ceiling to floor.

$115/hr · two-person crew All supplies included All-natural products No contract

What's included

Exactly what gets done, room by room.

This is the whole list, not a summary of it. If something is on it, the crew does it every visit without being asked. If it is not on it, ask us — we will tell you yes or no before the day, not after.

Kitchen

  • Sinks & counters
  • Appliance exteriors
  • Polish fixtures
  • Load dishwasher
  • Range hood inside and out

Bathrooms

  • Shower & tub with detail scrub
  • Toilet
  • Sinks & counters
  • Polish fixtures
  • Clean mirrors

All rooms

  • Dust furniture
  • Cabinets and drawer exteriors
  • Vacuum floors and rugs
  • Mop floors
  • Make beds
  • Remove trash
  • Ceiling fans
  • Light fixtures
  • Vents
  • Woodwork
  • Furniture
  • All decorative items
  • Vacuum upholstery
  • Hand-wipe all baseboards

Our move-in/out package includes no time cap, to ensure your home gets the cleaning attention it deserves. It is a pre-selected package for all sizes, so nobody is watching a clock at the end of a move.

Honest limits

What is not on the list.

Published checklists are only worth anything if they are also a boundary. These are the jobs a move in / move out does not include as standard. None of them is a refusal — most are things we will happily quote — but you should not discover that on the day.

Ask when you book and we will tell you the time it adds before you commit to it.

Not included as standard

  • Inside the oven and inside the refrigerator
  • Exterior windows
  • Laundry, or dishes beyond loading the dishwasher
  • Anything needing a ladder above standard reach
  • Garages, patios and outdoor living areas

When to book it

Is this the one I need?

Three ways this clean is normally used. If none of them sounds like your house, say so on the phone — we would rather move you to the right one than sell you this one.

01

Getting a deposit back

The clean a landlord or property manager inspects against is not the clean you live with. This is the one that passes.

02

Before your furniture lands

An empty house is the only time anyone reaches the backs of cabinets, the tops of doors and behind where the fridge is going to sit.

03

Selling, or handing over

Listing photographs, an open house, or a key handover where you would rather not be apologising for the previous owner.

Questions

About the move in / move out.

More answers — including the cancellation policy in full — are on the homepage.

What does “no time cap” actually mean?

That the visit is not cut short at a pre-agreed number of hours. An empty house takes what it takes, and the alternative — stopping at three hours with the second bathroom half done — helps nobody. You are still billed at the published hourly rate for the time spent.

Should I book before or after the movers?

After, for a move-out; before, for a move-in. Both work best on an empty house — a room with boxes in it cannot be cleaned to this list, and we would rather tell you that now than on the day.

Do you clean inside the cabinets?

Yes. Inside every cabinet and drawer, and appliances inside and out. That is the difference between this and a deep clean.
